title: loadpath enclosure brief
description: `loadpath enclosure`: a product from its outside in (enclosure.py). The designer's exterior is fixed (kept as the study's skin, never edited); the components are placed inside it (placement.py) or taken as given, each gets its assembly path, a mount, and its share of the loads (drops, squeezes, presses, plugs, heat, a push pad, feel targets); the interior is designed.

heightfield.description: One side of a surface given as heights over a plane: the points whose n.x is below (or above) h(u, v), h on a square grid in the plane's axes, bilinear between samples. A stepped or curved parting surface (loadpath split writes these).

mesh.description: A closed mesh: an STL/3MF/OBJ path relative to the study's folder (or a STEP file, .step/.stp, tessellated and healed; needs loadpath[step]), or inline stlBase64.

brep.description: An exact CAD solid (build.py, docs/BUILD.md): a build123d or CadQuery object in a Python file beside the study, as 'cad.py:name' (a module-level solid, or a function with no arguments that returns one), or a STEP file. Its faces and edges are kept: a build cuts and adds with the solid itself, and the checks read its fillet radii from the CAD kernel. The Python file is run, so it is the agent's own file. Needs loadpath[step].

tolerance.description: mm the tessellation may stray from a curved face (default 0.005)

sdf.description: A sampled signed distance field: an .npz (distance, origin, pitch; mm, negative inside) relative to the study's folder, as loadpath.exterior.save_sdf writes it, or an OpenVDB level set (.vdb, from Houdini, Blender, nTop or `loadpath sdf`). How an SDF tool's shape (libfive, the sdf package, a field graph) comes in.

shroud.description: a generated exterior by its key (what a shroud block expands to; `loadpath shroud`)

union.description: Several shapes acting as one region (a servo's four screw bosses).

intersect.description: Where all the shapes overlap: a half ring is a tube intersected with a box.

subtract.description: The first shape with the others cut away: a ring with a gap is a tube minus a box.

shape.title: a shape object (box, cylinder, tube, sphere, heightfield, mesh, brep, sdf, union, intersect, subtract)
shape.description: A shape: box, cylinder (tube), sphere, heightfield, mesh, brep, sdf, union, intersect or subtract. Units mm.
